title: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.07513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. translated_title: Concertina：在单一扩散视觉语言模型中融合操作与认知
translated_abstract: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过在视觉语言模型（VLM）上外挂一个独立的动作机制，将操作与认知解耦——要么将动作量化为离散词元（其误差与物理位移之间没有稳定的对应关系），要么将连续轨迹生成交给一个独立的动作专家模块（其梯度会与VLM主干产生竞争，或被阻止更新VLM主干）。我们认为操作与认知应当内化于同一个模型之中，即从解耦的VLA转向具身视觉语言模型（eVLM）。我们提出了Concertina，这是一种eVLM，它将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接置于共享的扩散VLM主干的计算与参数路径上。每个控制时间步被编码为主干隐藏空间中的一个连续潜在动作词元，由共享的Transformer进行重建（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出Concertina——一种具身视觉语言模型（eVLM），将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接融入共享的扩散VLM主干，使操作与认知统一在同一模型中，避免了传统VLA解耦架构的量化误差和梯度竞争问题。
en_tdlr: Concertina is an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM) that unifies manipulation and cognition by embedding continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly into a shared diffusion VLM backbone, eliminating the quantization errors and gradient competition of decoupled VLA architectures.
